text:
nina: emergency meeting to admire Quinoa, my miniature pig, who has adopted the devops closet as her sock hoard. Photo: https://imgur.com/a/quinoa-socks :pig: :socks:
omar: iconic. is she sorting by color, or is this a mood-based curation? also is she accepting onboarding treats? :thinking_face: :cookie:
beau: She curated my left sneaker this morning. found it under the PR whiteboard. Quinoa is a stealth reviewer. :eyes: :clipboard:
riley: camera notes: `Sony RX100, 1/200s, natural light`, slight crop to capture sock pile. no zoom required, Quinoa presents herself dramatically. :camera_flash:
nina: she prefers argyles and has strong feelings about ankle socks. if you leave a toe out, it will be taken as a sign of vulnerability. :sweat_smile: I put a sign: "Quinoa Approved If Sock Fits". Etsy link for tiny hats if anyone wants to bribe her: https://etsy.com/listing/quinoa-hats.
beau: adopting her for our next retro. agenda item: "How many socks are too many?" also proposing a tiny podium so she can deliver quarterly morale updates. :microphone:
omar: logistics question: is small-pet insurance required? Facilities will ban sock-hoarding if it threatens keyboard safety. :grimacing: @facilities-bot any notes?
facilities-bot: Reminder: Non-service animals must be supervised in common areas. Please consult the pets policy for shared-space guidance: https://intranet/company/pets-policy. Keep food away from keyboards and report lost items to Facilities. :information_source:
riley: scientific observation: Quinoa differentiates socks by scent. She left my keyboard alone but rearranged my sticker collection by adhesive strength. Highly opinionated. :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
nina: Poll: Should Quinoa be allowed in the office on Fridays for "Sock Sorting Sessions"? React with :pig: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. Current votes: nina :pig:, beau :pig:, omar :pig:, riley :pig:. unanimous so far.
beau: tiny merch idea: "Quinoa's Sock Rescue" enamel pin. I will prototype tomorrow. who wants one? quick poll reaction with :handshake: if interested.
omar: Also curious: Does she accept resumes? I have a draft for "Senior Sock Strategist" I can forward. :page_with_curl:
nina: last logistics: if you bring open-toe shoes, consider them donated. Quinoa will accept them for research and maybe return them with notes. Approach with caution and snacks. :banana:
